regions.today: A brighter day overall with any residual overnight rain and drizzle quickly clearing eastwards early this morning, followed by a mix of cloudy periods, sunny spells, and a scattering of light showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 or 22 degrees, with light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tonight: A mainly dry start with well scattered showers and the odd clear spell before cloud and outbreaks of rain spread from the west and southwest through the night. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A rather wet start to the day, though the rain will become patchier and more intermittent during the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 15 to 21 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Wednesday. Low on Thursday.
